method: Full pinned source read, Git/SHA256 validation; compiled unchanged source and authored canary control using a32-byte output buffer.
findings: BLAKE2s uses64-byte blocks,32-bit lanes,64-bit counter with carry and retains final full block for padding/final flag. Key block is cleared after initialization.

Final checks outlen>=configured digest length but copies outlen rather than configured S->outlen, unlike BLAKE2b. Control with configured16-byte digest and32-byte output writes all32 bytes, changing16 trailing canary bytes. Output lengths beyond internal32-byte temporary would exceed source-buffer bounds by code inspection; that case was not executed.
Repeated final is rejected; conditional selftest depends on absent blake2-kat.h. No independent digest oracle run for this implementation in this step.
